personality_one_liner: A highly functional, utility-driven B2B wholesale ordering experience wrapped in a clean, warm, and highly legible iOS-native framework.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for catalog clarity. Minimal nested padding in list items to keep high information density while preserving touch targets.

dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. This is a purely functional B2B utility where flat, high-contrast surfaces ensure maximum readability during fast order processing.

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: A streamlined entry point for ordering, highlighting new catalog additions and quick access to previous orders.

states.empty: No items added yet. Browse the catalog to start.
states.error: Failed to load catalog. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Use a top navigation bar with search. Hero banner using a subtle tint or image backdrop for 'Wholesale Specials'. Below, a two-column grid layout (Pinterest-style) for featured products, ensuring clear visibility of unit pricing, MOQs, and an immediate 'Add to Cart' button.

screens.name: Product Catalogue
screens.purpose: The core browsing experience for buyers to view products, select variations, and add quantities to cart.

states.empty: No products found matching your filters.
states.error: Could not load products. Pull to refresh.

screens.layout: Sticky filter and sorting controls at the top. Stacked list or two-column grid (depending on density). Product cards must display thumbnail, title, SKU, price (if visible), and a quantity stepper right on the card to reduce friction.

screens.name: Cart / Order Builder
screens.purpose: Review selected items and quantities, calculate totals, and proceed to checkout.

states.empty: Your cart is empty. Continue shopping.

screens.layout: List view of cart items with prominent quantity steppers and a swipe-to-delete action. A sticky bottom section (fixed above safe area) for total cost summary and the primary 'Submit Order' CTA.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview for staff to quickly process incoming orders and update statuses.
screens.layout: Status-based tabs (Pending, Processing, Shipped) at the top. A stacked list of order cards underneath showing Order ID, Customer Name, Total, and a status chip. Tapping a card opens a modal sheet to quickly update status.

kitchenware_hero.alt: 3 stainless steel cooking pots on white ceramic tiles

kitchen_atelier_logo.alt: stainless steel cooking pots on stainless steel tray used as logo placeholder

instructions_to_main_agent: Focus on utility and speed over heavy styling. This is a functional B2B tool. Skip complex animations.
Enforce the warm, neutral palette using cream/off-white (`#F9F7F3`) for the background, and terracotta (`#BF5D39`) for CTAs. Avoid generic blues or purples.
Make sure touch targets for the quantity steppers are large enough (≥ 44x44pt).
Include both Customer and Admin flows cleanly using role-based routing or a toggle.
When displaying price, read the settings state (Admin toggle for Price Display).
Stick to Geist for all typography, using 400 for body and 500 max for headings to keep the UI clean and readable.
Ensure the 'Submit Order' or 'Checkout' CTA in the cart is sticky at the bottom, outside the scroll view, so users do not have to hunt for it.
Use solid background for bottom tab bar and headers. As per app category and requirement, glassmorphism is disabled.
